shared_elements: internal division into compartments by straight lines
row of small repeated vertical marks along a lower edge
justification: Both surfaces show a bounded rectangular field subdivided by straight lines with a row of small repeated tick-like marks along a lower register, which is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows only an austere linear grid or vessel-like outline with no figures, while B is densely populated with human figures, a central tree-like axis, scrolls, elaborate headdresses and glyph-like ornament — an entirely different order of iconographic content.
